# Mock data (generated by `db/seeds/seed.mjs`)

> **All shops, people, phone numbers, GSTINs, barcodes, prices and invoices are fictional.** Pilot city is undecided (D-23); a Bengaluru cluster is used only so distance search has realistic coordinates. Invoice amounts are placeholders because plan prices are undecided (D-22).
> Regenerate: `pnpm db:seed` (wipes all tenant data; keeps reference data). Deterministic: same input gives the same shops and products.

## Scenarios to test (where to find them)
| Scenario | What it shows | Example |

| Fresh, available | green label, "updated Xh ago" | Screen Guard Moto G54 Tempered @ Khan Electronics & Electricals — Lalbagh Road; Maxx Binder Clips 51mm @ Patel Stationers — Jayanagar 9th Block |
| Limited stock | at or below the low-stock threshold | Kangaro Binder Clips 15mm @ Patel Stationers — Jayanagar 9th Block; Samsung Memory Card 128GB @ Mobile Zone Accessories — Jayanagar Shopping Complex |
| Out of stock | trusted zero | Fuse Wire 5A @ Gupta Electricals — Basavanagudi; Nerolac Wall Emulsion 10L Brilliant White @ Sharma Hardware & Paints — JP Nagar 2nd Phase |
| Negative stock (D-01) | sale recorded at zero stock → flagged, public "check with shop", discrepancy review item | Primer 10L Wall @ Sharma Hardware & Paints — Jayanagar 4th Block; Crompton Wall Fan 400mm Black @ Gupta Electricals — Basavanagudi; boAt Headphones Bluetooth @ Khan Electronics & Electricals — Lalbagh Road |
| Stale native update (>24h) | label degrades to "check with shop" | Screen Guard Moto G54 Tempered @ Khan Electronics & Electricals — Shanti Nagar; Oppo Mobile Charger Micro-USB 20W @ Khan Electronics & Electricals — Lalbagh Road |
| CSV-sourced stock (72h TTL) | fresh vs stale CSV imports | Oppo Mobile Charger Micro-USB 20W @ Khan Electronics & Electricals — Lalbagh Road; Door Hinge 3" Silver @ Sharma Hardware & Paints — Jayanagar 4th Block; Paperkraft Notebook Double Line 200 pages Long @ Patel Stationers — Jayanagar 9th Block |
| Status-only products | "mark in/out of stock" tracking (Patel Stationers, Lakshmi Book & Stationery) | 57 status-only balances |

## Try the search (demo point: 12.9352, 77.5806, radius 6 km)
```sql
SELECT shop_name, branch_name, product_name, distance_m, label, price_paise, open_state
FROM search_listings('pankha', 12.9352, 77.5806, 6000);          -- Hinglish
SELECT product_name, label FROM search_listings('पंखा', 12.9352, 77.5806, 6000);   -- Hindi
SELECT product_name, label FROM search_listings('led bulb 9w', 12.9352, 77.5806, 6000);
```
Run with `pnpm db:psql`.
